verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase works inside the console on the user's own project data. It gives actionable insights on Crashlytics crashes (issue description, likely root causes, fix suggestions), summarizes messaging campaigns with performance recommendations, and analyzes logs and error messages. missing for 10: evidence of AI insights over general app data (e.g., Firestore contents or analytics beyond crashes and messaging), independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
